Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies project management expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable project managers based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered project management systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to project management frameworks, timeline planning, risk assessment, stakeholder communication, and reporting - Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, practicality, and compliance with real-world project management practices - Draft realistic project management scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. project manager, client, team member, or sponsor) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated project management content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects solid project management reasoning, authentic documentation, and practical procedures. advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs mid to expert level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but is not limited to: observing devises in operation to location root cause of problem; dismantling devices to gain access to and remove defective parts; examining parts to detect imperfections; adjustment of functional parts of devices and control instruments; repair and/or replacement of defective parts; testing of device to observe performance; and performing tests for electrical circuitry and mechanical systems; reconditioning and repairing machine tools. · Identifies and sources parts, supplies and repair items as necessary. · Independently performs maintenance as per industry standards. · May be required to setup and operate multiple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform welding tasks. · Complies with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Drives and participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history. · Troubleshoots and analyzes control systems to resolve software/ hardware and configuration problems. · Utilizes predictive maintenance technologies to collect equipment performance data. · Provides assistance to lower level technicians and leadership to small teams. Performs more advanced functions as a part of training and development. · Completes on-the-job and technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus and 3 years of related experience in general industry; or 5 years of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understands electrical, mechanical, fluid power and control systems. Can analyze problems and perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools and specialized tools as appropriate · May be required to travel. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:846.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Box Office Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the ticket selling staff. The Box Office Supervisor will resolve customer service concerns and troubleshoot issues that arise with ticketing software and the point of sale system. This position will also supervise the building of events in ticketing software and coordinate each show with the marketing department. Essential Functions Responsible for supervision of ticket sellers. Ensure that all employees are fulfilling their job responsibilities and advising staff when necessary. Responsible for training of ticketing staff. Assist manager with scheduling and disseminate the schedule for department, ensuring all shifts are filled properly. Accurately reconcile all credential inventory and equipment to ensure proper check in at the end of each shift. Resolve customer service issues and complaints. Work with department to fix issues related to customer service complaints when appropriate. Troubleshoot any issues relating to software or point of sale system. May be responsible for the organization of staff meetings, acceptance and payment of deliveries. May review ticketing information for each show built, validating prices and dates are correct. Coordinate show builds with marketing department. Required Qualifications Years of related work experience: 3 Strong computer skills with a proficiency in MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook) Excellent written, listening, and verbal communication skills and experience in conflict resolution Experience in a supervisory role Must be able to work flexible schedule, including: nights, weekends and some holidays Ability to effectively supervise, motivate, and lead a productive team. Knowledge and interest in live entertainment preferred Payscale: $18.75 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification). AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description. AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants. We are an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any individual, employee, or application for employment on the basis of race, color, marital status, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other legally protected status recognized by federal, state or local law. Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:8b1209c1-9c3.description: Open Vacancy: This role is a current, active position and we are accepting applications. Our client is the world's first and only Business Agency. They bring business strategy to brand storytelling to drive enterprise value. With expertise in strategy, media, CRM, creative, performance marketing, and technology, the agency creates integrated marketing systems and campaigns that grow businesses in significant ways. About the Role The agency is currently seeking a Vice President, Client Partner to join their growing team. The Vice President is a senior business leader who owns the strategic direction, growth, and profitability of a significant portfolio and the agency's most important client relationships, with a book of business of $15–25MM+. This is a step beyond account leadership — the VP is expected to operate as an executive-level strategic partner to clients, a driver of new revenue both within existing accounts and through new business, and a people leader responsible for building and developing a large, high-performing team. The Vice President reports to a Managing Director and serves as a key member of the agency's client leadership bench — trusted to represent the agency at the executive table, to shape how the agency shows up in the market, and to mentor the next generation of account leadership.

Experienced building, leading, and scaling a large team, including managing other senior leaders (Directors and Group Account Directors) who in turn manage their own teams.
Strong story-telling and strategic development capabilities, with the ability to build and deliver executive-level presentations and points of view.

Skilled at identifying needs a client may not yet recognize, and connecting the agency's cross-functional capabilities — strategy, media, CRM, creative, performance marketing, and technology — to solve for them.
A natural relationship builder who consistently develops new executive-level relationships and represents the agency's point of view in the broader industry.
Full ownership of portfolio profitability, including negotiating scopes and fees with clients and partnering with the agencyleadership on resourcing and margin.
A passionate people leader with a track record of mentoring, developing, and retaining talent across a diverse and growing team.

axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: A rapidly growing animal health and diagnostics business is seeking a senior commercial lawyer to provide broad‑based legal support across Australia and New Zealand. This highly visible role partners closely with commercial stakeholders to deliver pragmatic advice on day‑to‑day legal and compliance matters, while reviewing, drafting, and negotiating a wide range of commercial agreements in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. The position also advises on regulatory issues within a highly regulated sector and contributes to improving contracting processes as the business scales. The opportunity suits a self‑starter with strong generalist experience, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a practical, business‑focused approach. Responsibilities: Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of commercial agreements, including customer, service, supply and distribution, SaaS, and technology‑related contracts. Support negotiations for both routine commercial deals and complex, highly negotiated strategic customer arrangements. Partner closely with commercial teams to deliver pragmatic legal guidance, manage risk, and enable business outcomes. Provide legal support for the integration of an acquired technology business, including an increasing volume of SaaS‑related contracting. Drive contracting efficiency by developing templates, building playbooks, enhancing knowledge management, and strengthening contracting capability across the commercial team. Advise on life sciences regulatory requirements, support day‑to‑day legal and compliance matters, and collaborate with stakeholders across the business in a fast‑paced, highly regulated environment. Strong generalist legal skillset with experience across a broad range of commercial and corporate matters. Self-starter with a practical, hands-on approach, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal onboarding in a hybrid work environment. Why Rejoin Axiom? Flexibility: Choose assignments that fit your lifestyle and career goals. Professional Growth: Continue to develop your expertise through diverse projects. Community: Reconnect with a network of forward-thinking legal professionals. Impact: Contribute to impactful work with leading global organizations. Compensation, Benefits & Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, pension and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiomites predominately work remotely, with the exception that some clients require on-site presence. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:28a3d5f9-.title: Security Controls Engineer
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:28a3d5f9-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: We’re looking for an independent, driven security professional who thrives at the intersection of security, DevOps, and delivery. In this role, you will translate legal and security framework requirements into clear, actionable vulnerability management and remediation programs that operate across multiple Security and DevOps teams. You’ll help design, operationalize, and continually improve our vulnerability management lifecycle, from identification and triage through prioritization and remediation to validation and reporting. This includes secure development practices within regulatory frameworks guiding vulnerability handling, coordinated disclosure, SBOM transparency, patch management, and post-deployment monitoring. You will track, report, and escalate progress, risks, and dependencies, partnering closely with a Senior Project Manager and reporting to senior leadership. If you enjoy making complex requirements practical, measurable, and delivered—this is for you. Key Responsibilities: - Translate requirements → action: Break down legal, regulatory (including Cyber Resiliency Act), and security framework obligations into prioritized, testable tasks for engineering and platform teams. Define concrete technical control requirements across vulnerability detection, remediation SLAs, secure configuration baselines, SBOM management, and coordinated disclosure processes. - Own the vulnerability management lifecycle: Drive end-to-end vulnerability management across infrastructure, cloud, applications, containers, and third-party components—including scanning, triage, risk-based prioritization (CVSS + exploitability + business impact), remediation tracking, validation, and closure. - Integrate security into CI/CD: Partner closely with the Application Security team to support SAST, DAST, SCA, container, IaC, and cloud configuration scanning into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure findings are automatically ticketed, risk-ranked, and tracked to resolution with measurable SLAs. - Orchestrate implementation: Coordinate work across multiple security domains (e.g., IAM, vuln mgmt, cloud security, appsec) and DevOps/Platform teams to drive consistent adoption. - Plan & track delivery: Build delivery plans, track milestones, manage dependencies, and maintain a single source of truth (e.g., Jira/Azure Boards). - Stakeholder management: Align with product owners, architects, and security SMEs; resolve blockers and facilitate decisions. - Metrics & reporting: Develop actionable dashboards that show vulnerability aging, SLA compliance, backlog trends, recurring vulnerability patterns, report status

interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:26ca2769-0db.description: LOCATION New York, NY, USA Hybrid (2-3 days a week in Office) JOB DESCRIPTION Interplay is looking for a Partner to lead and scale our new private equity division. Interplay is a startup ecosystem that supports founders via venture capital, an accelerator, a studio, a platform of core business services, and a multi-family office. This new division will focus on acquiring control and meaningful minority positions in established, profitable private companies by generating attractive risk-adjusted returns through disciplined sourcing, value creation, and operational improvement. We’re going to be taking a uniquely long-term view when we invest; this role will likely appeal to strategic thinkers that want to use duration as an advantage. The right person for this role will have the opportunity to build and grow a best-in-class private equity platform within Interplay, achieving financial success and professional fulfillment in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a high-caliber investment professional with deep expertise in buyout investing, valuation, deal structuring, and operational value creation. This person will work closely with the other partners at Interplay to establish and scale our private equity practice. This could be the last stop in this person's career. The concepts come easily to you, you know you're capable of doing big things and you feel as though your ability to spread your wings professionally is throttled by your experience not your capabilities. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c3f197d-0808-.title: Project Director – Fibre Commercialization
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c3f197d-0808-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Director – Fibre Commercialization based in Canada. This role provides strategic, commercial, and delivery leadership for major fibre commercialization initiatives supporting large-scale connectivity investments. You will shape commercialization strategies across pricing, access models, partnerships, and revenue opportunities. The position combines infrastructure expertise with commercial planning, financial analysis, procurement, and stakeholder management. You will work across complex projects involving telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, service providers, and senior government stakeholders. A key focus will be creating sustainable commercial models that support long-term infrastructure value and service delivery. The role offers significant influence over strategic decisions, agreements, governance frameworks, and commercialization roadmaps. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced infrastructure leader who can translate complex investments into commercially viable outcomes. Define and lead commercialization strategies for fibre assets, including pricing models, access frameworks, partnership structures, and revenue opportunities. Develop and maintain multi-year commercialization roadmaps aligned with capital planning, infrastructure investments, and broader organizational priorities. Identify and evaluate revenue-generation opportunities such as wholesale bandwidth services, co-location, access arrangements, and strategic partnerships. Provide commercial oversight for fibre-related components of major infrastructure initiatives, ensuring alignment between delivery objectives and commercialization plans. Lead or participate in negotiations with telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, vendors, and service providers. Develop and manage commercial agreements, including access agreements, service contracts, partnership frameworks, and related documentation. Provide commercial and strategic input into procurement activities, including RFP development, evaluation criteria, vendor selection, and contract structuring. Develop and maintain financial models covering capital recovery, operating costs, revenue projections, pricing assumptions, and cost-recovery strategies. Establish governance structures for commercialization decisions, including reporting, accountability, oversight, risk management, and decision-making processes. Ensure fibre commercialization initiatives support broader connectivity, digital transformation, economic development, and sustainable service-delivery objectives. Prepare strategic recommendations, briefing materials, risk assessments, and commercial updates for senior leadership. Deliver key commercialization outputs, including implementation roadmaps, partnership models, financial plans, procurement documentation, governance frameworks, and stakeholder engagement plans. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 10+ years of progressive experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, large-scale project delivery, commercial strategy, or program management. Demonstrated experience leading commercial, procurement, partnership, or business-development activities for major infrastructure initiatives. jobgether-jobgether:lever:64f902c9-cb99-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Netherlands. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. The position plays a key role in ensuring quality issues are identified, investigated, and resolved efficiently across the commercial supply chain. You will collaborate closely with Quality, Sales, Commercial Operations, and Supply Chain stakeholders to strengthen compliance and operational performance. Act as a liaison between Quality, Sales, Commercial Operations, Supply Chain, and other business partners on commercial and distribution quality matters. Investigate and drive timely resolution of quality issues using structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis approaches. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and root-cause analysis capabilities. Proven ability to manage projects, priorities, timelines, and competing responsibilities effectively. Ability to work independently with limited supervision while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical and compliance concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. Supplier Quality Management experience is preferred. Benefits: Anticipated base salary range of $79,000–$127,650 . The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. You will still support Sales, but your first question every day is: how do we help our customers get more value, faster? travix-travix:greenhouse:8653150002.description: Job Purpose The Business Data Analyst works in a multi-functional data & analytics team responsible for driving initiatives to improve the use of data and automated processes to drive generation of valuable insights for Travix. Your main responsibility is to identify, formulate and execute data projects that will provide the maximum value in unlocking new data assets and insights for the business teams and Travix as a whole. As part of our centralized data team, your analysis work reaches multiple business units. Your analysis will serve as the single source of truth that teams across the company rely on for decision-making. You are expected to be Travix’s in-house expert in best practices of utilizing data, generating insights and identifying the safe ways of utilizing AI, LLMs in data analytics. As a Business Data Analyst you work with multiple business teams with one of them being your primary focus. Core tasks and responsibilities Working with internal business stakeholders to understand major challenges and opportunities. Brainstorm and execute solutions that involve advanced applied analytics methodologies. Develop in-depth understanding of main priorities and challenges that business teams have. Highlight opportunities for better use of existing data sources, identify data blind spots and a strategy for fixing them with close collaboration with data engineering team In Shanghai. Develop and lead key complex analytical projects that build foundations for data analysis and generate insights. This includes setting up in-house data modeling tools using SQL and Python. Create complex SQL queries that transform data into ready-to-use optimized datasets Build KPI-driven dashboards and analytical tools to help business stakeholders to optimize a process of insights generation supporting data-driven decision making. Provide deep dives into company and business team performance. Communicate insights generated in a clear story and provide strategic and tactical recommendations. Have a proactive stakeholder management, where you spread the results of your work and gathered insights with multiple stakeholders within the company as single source of truth. Be the primary point of contact for all analytical/data questions for the business team (especially the focused business team). What you bring to the table Education Bachelor or Master degree in Business, Econometrics, or another relevant study or equivalent practical experience Experience More than 5 years experience as Data or BI Analyst Strong business intuition and ability to understand complex business systems Strong technical accomplishments in SQL and data analysis skills Expertise in visualization technologies using modern BI tools Advanced ability to leverage LLMs for SQL generation, Python scripting, and data summarization A solid foundation on data modeling concepts Having experience with analytics and analytical framework for the business team that will be the priority focus Experience identifying and pitching new analytical tools and analysis including project that leverage the potential of AI , LLMs Soft skills Analytical, problem-solver and solutions-focused Can-do mentality, performance-driven, flexible Independent as well as team-player able to collaborate successfully with multiple cross-functional stakeholders with diverse levels of understanding of analytics Demonstrated ability to develop, communicate and execute analytical projects Ability to communicate data-heavy insights & recommendations in a simple story Strong stakeholder management skills, including working with C-suite Be able to facilitate and lead meetings to influence stakeholder decisions with data-driven insights What you can expect from us 🕒 Enjoy the flexibility and life balance of hybrid work where each team aligns on their minimum number of days in office to foster collaboration and meet the team's needs. 🏖️ Possibility to work up to 90 days from abroad (depending on your job function) ✈️ 31,5
